objective: Auditar el estado AS-IS canónico de capacidades de globalización/localización y master data en EDARSAHUB para países, monedas, tipos de cambio, idiomas/locales, zonas horarias, unidades de medida, conversiones, calendarios, horarios operativos, formatos, impuestos, direcciones, identificadores fiscales e identificadores bancarios. SQL Server EDARSAHUB permanece como fuente canónica. No modificar código, datos, esquema, RBAC, menús, Layout, Scheduler, NetPay ni Production; no crear duplicados ni crecer Core.

queries.name: globalization_schema_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' AND (LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%pais%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%country%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%moneda%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%currency%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%cambio%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%exchange%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%idioma%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%locale%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%zona%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%time%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%measure%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%conversion%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%calendar%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%calendario%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%horario%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%format%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%impuesto%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%tax%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%direccion%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%address%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%fiscal%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%banco%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%bank%') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: globalization_column_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%pais%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%country%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%moneda%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%currency%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%tipo_cambio%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%exchange%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%idioma%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%locale%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%timezone%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%zona_horaria%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%unidad_medida%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%impuesto%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%direccion%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%fiscal%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%clabe%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%iban%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%swift%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
